seo.title: Alina Zelinska — Ukrainian Tutor, Translator & Poet
seo.description: Alina Zelinska (movAlina) is a native Ukrainian tutor from Ukraine teaching Ukrainian, English and Russian online. 3,500+ lessons, 500+ students, 5.0.

hero.title: Alina Zelinska — Ukrainian tutor, translator and *poet*
hero.lede: I'm a native Ukrainian tutor from Ukraine. Since April 2022 I've taught 3,500+ one-to-one lessons of Ukrainian, English and Russian to 500+ students from 30+ countries.

story.title: Why I *teach*
paragraphs: Language has been my world for as long as I can remember. Ukrainian and Russian are my native languages, I speak English fluently, and I'm learning Spanish and German — so I know what it feels like to be the student.

My lessons are conversations, not lectures. I bring culture, stories, humour and real-life context into every session and build each lesson around you: your pace, your interests, your goals. On italki I've kept a perfect 5.0 rating with 100% attendance.
Outside lessons I write poetry in Ukrainian, Russian and English, translate poems between languages — trying to carry the feeling, not just the meaning — and write songs.

about.career: Before teaching, I co-founded an eco-friendly haircare brand, Eco.April.Shampoo, and a craft games platform, CraftGames.ua.
